name: tasks
title: Tasks
description: A production task board made only with mangacn: a Data Table whose statuses are stamps (ink for everyday statuses, the accent colour only for Blocked), a search Input, status filters as pressed buttons, actions on the selected rows (Button Group: mark done, reopen, delete) and a ImpactCounter of finished tasks.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/tasks". The root fills its container: pass className="h-svh" for a whole screen.

meta.tagline: A task board: stamps for statuses, filters and actions on a selection.
